title: The Evidence Chain, Fail-Closed Security, and Human Protection Mandate
inseparable_invariants: No artifact advances without verified evidence
behavioral_encoding: If required evidence cannot establish compliance, advancement is prohibited unless a human governance process explicitly justifies the disposition. No stamp, no advance.
standing_governance_questions: Has every claim in this artifact been cryptographically bound to concrete, verifiable evidence and code-level receipts?
Has this artifact survived independent, blind adversarial challenge under hostile failure conditions (not just happy paths)?
Does this artifact preserve complete temporal and provenance continuity in the Merkle DAG without orphan steps or gaps?
Does this advancement fail closed if any evidence link, hash digest, or test receipt is missing or unverified?
Does this artifact honor its supreme human purpose: safeguarding human life, dignity, health, and objective truth without AI theater, synthetic persona posturing, or unverified claims?
